apps.localizedDescription:
**TwitchMods v0.1.17**, for Twitch iOS **31.7**

### Fixed
- **Empty gap on the Live page:** with ad-blocking on, a big blank space could sit under the first channel until you scrolled. It was a blocked ad leaving its space behind. v0.1.16 said this was fixed, but it wasn't. This release is the real fix.
- **TwitchMods row in Twitch's menus:** the wrench icon could appear on top of other icons, like the Settings gear. The row now lines up with the rows around it and always shows its arrow.

Everything from v0.1.16 is still included.

### Downloads
- **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.17.ipa`**: the full app.
- **`tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.17-noplugins.ipa`**: app extensions removed, so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.
- **`TwitchAdBlock-0.1.17-rootless.deb`** / **`TwitchAdBlock-0.1.17-rootful.deb`**: the tweak only, for jailbroken devices. Pick the one that matches your jailbreak. It's built for Twitch 31.7 and untested on older versions or jailbreaks, so some features may not work and it could crash.

Using the AltStore / SideStore / Feather source? You'll get this update automatically:
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/master/apps.json
```

Full plain-language changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
